NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Answer Key Notice 2026 – Full Details

National Board of Examination (NBE) has released the Answer Key Notice for the Group A, B & C Various post Exam 2026. Applications for the NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 07 July 2026, to 20 July 2026. The Examination is going to conducted on 05-06 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Answer Key Notice from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 15-16 September 2026 Revised
  • Admit Card : 11 September 2026
  • Answer Key Date : 02 October 2026
  • Result Available : Will be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1500/- (+18% GST Extra)
  • SC, ST, PH & Female : Rs. 00/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Answer Key Notice 2026?

NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Answer Key Notice 2026 contains the official answers. Candidates can verify their responses and submit objections if required.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
